quote_excerpts: the "OFF" one is the best result by a long shot, smoothest and feels best.
If I had to choose an ironed one, it would probably be the entire right hand column of "30%" flow ones. The 60/30 feels more papery than the other two.
But, just make a note of that and turn *off* ironing and start us a new print of a reservoir and cap on mark2. bed is clear.

observations.best_overall_finish: Smoothest and feels best by a long shot.

scope: Visual and tactile operator assessment of flat PETG squares on Mark2 with the left 0.8 mm Standard hotend. This is a finish selection; it supplies no reservoir water-hold, seal-compression or lifetime result.
